LHWR Plot Control

Source: R/plot.R
lhwr_plot_control.Rd

Create a small list of graphical defaults used by the high-level LHWR Poincare disk plotting functions. Most users can ignore this helper and use the plotting functions directly. It is useful when preparing publication figures or when labels and legends need to be larger or smaller.

Usage

lhwr_plot_control(
  label_cex = 0.55,
  degree_cex = 0.5,
  legend_cex = 0.55,
  colorbar_cex = 0.55,
  title_cex = 1.2,
  info_cex = 0.55,
  point_min = 0.45,
  point_max = 2.8
)

Arguments

label_cex

Character expansion for observation labels.

degree_cex

Character expansion for degree labels on the disk boundary.

legend_cex

Character expansion for categorical and size legends.

colorbar_cex

Character expansion for colorbar text.

title_cex

Character expansion for plot titles.

info_cex

Character expansion for the optional information box.

point_min, point_max

Minimum and maximum point sizes after scaling.

Value

A list that can be passed to plot_control in plot_lhwr_poincare_map(), plot_lhwr_embedding(), or plot_lhwr_network_map().

Examples

H <- simulate_H2(30, r_max = 2)
ctl <- lhwr_plot_control(label_cex = 0.65, legend_cex = 0.65)
plot_lhwr_embedding(H$Z, values = H$r, plot_control = ctl)
